surface_profile.materials: Original restrained natural palette; no source pixels, copied reconstruction palette or fossil mineral colors.
surface_profile.normal_style: Deliberate broad anatomical planes, continuous transitions; no asserted fossil skin texture or gratuitous scales.

view_plan.greybox_note: Four inexpensive graybox views first: deep head, smooth-spine tall sail and continuous root, sprawling stance, long tapering tail, complete feet. Final evidence from exact imported GLB.

name.zh: 异齿龙（D. milleri 启发成年形态）

scope: Original static whole-animal evidence-informed stylization, existing planned genus ID; not specimen replica, not exact species anatomical restoration.

taxon.form_anchor: Harvard Museum D. milleri type specimen illustrated by holding museum
taxon.context: Early Permian; no precise locality scene or coexistence asserted

scale.basis: Artistic target below museum-reported approximately 2 m D. milleri length; not measured fossil.
scale.note: All detailed proportions are art nominal targets; coherent silhouette takes precedence. Record final bounds separately; uniform scale only.

scientific_limits: No fossil color or skin pattern claimed. Smooth restrained surface is an artistic simplification, not evidence of scaleless skin.
Sail membrane, tissue thickness, lip coverage, eye appearance and neutral standing posture are interpretive. No claim sail purpose is established.
Harvard specimen side image is main proportional anchor but tail is cropped and mount includes reconstructed positioning; do not mirror its missing extent as actual tail termination.

Gilmore 1919 USNM 8635 historically D. gigas is genus-level supplementary skeletal context only, NOT D. milleri species evidence. Its mount combines individuals and plaster, historic lizard-derived pose; do not copy it as life-position proof.
No species-exact neural-spine count, tooth count, scale count or muscle reconstruction. No inferred internal organs.

morphology.obligation: Deep, substantial predator head, short neck, not small Edaphosaurus herbivore head. Broad cheek region behind eye, tapered snout without crocodile-length muzzle. Small relaxed jaw gap may expose one enlarged upper canine region per side plus restrained smaller teeth; no identical shark-tooth comb.
morphology.source: Harvard D. milleri specimen and Harvard dentition account; Gilmore as genus context.

morphology.obligation: Tall narrow midline dorsal sail with rounded high crest, rising behind neck, descending toward sacral/tail base. Continuous membrane volume smoothly rooted into dorsal body, not disconnected fence, stack of fins, or swollen hump. Subtle radial support rhythm allowed; no Edaphosaurus transverse crossbar knobs.
morphology.source: Harvard actual specimen pixels and explicit smooth-spine contrast.

morphology.obligation: Deep trunk with continuous shoulder/hip masses; visually narrower than a spherical barrel. Keep body underside clear of ground while feet contact ground; no dinosaur upright legs.
morphology.source: Harvard skeleton + genus supplementary rear plate.

morphology.obligation: Four short robust limbs with lateral upper-limb spread and bent joints; readable wrists/ankles and five tapered toe rays per foot, not paw lumps. No disconnected toes or pinned-on limbs.
morphology.source: Gilmore skeletal discussion and actual plates; count is genus-level conservative reconstruction, not milleri-specific assertion.

morphology.obligation: Long gradually narrowing muscular tail, broad integrated root; modest lateral curve only, distinct from sail. No paddle, spikes, terminal club, or abrupt cutoff.
morphology.source: Harvard long-tail account; complete extent art-nominal.

art_direction.palette: 4–6 opaque matte earth/moss neutral colors; body, subtly lighter underside, subdued sail, eye, ivory teeth/claws. Colors artistic, no source texture copying.
art_direction.construction: Purpose-built lofted anatomy; broad quiet facets and soft transitions, avoid repeated primitive/bead torso, visible sausage limb seams, or razor-thin membrane.
art_direction.sail_thickness_m: Art target 0.012–0.025 with thicker root; closed volume and readable rim. Not a biological measurement.

pose.description: Quiet alert four-foot standing pose with head toward -Y; sail upright +Z, tail +Y, slight asymmetry only if it preserves four-view comparison. No roaring, lunging, base or terrain.

acceptance_obligations: Maker must open actual reference image files before geometry, read scientific limits, inspect greybox front/side/top/perspective before polish.

Independent QA from clean import of exact final GLB: front -Y tests head width, central sail thickness, paired limb attachment and stance; side +X tests deep head, continuous tall sail, long tapered tail, ground contact; top +Z tests midline sail, limb spread, body/tail continuity and no hidden intersections; perspective (1,-1,1) tests coherence and readable distinctness from Edaphosaurus.
Check 4 limbs / 5 toe rays each, differentiated rather than uniformly repeated teeth when visible, no self-intersection, floating feet, detached sail or tail; if obscured add only targeted closeup.
Technical checks: triangle/material/primitive/byte ceilings, no external resources, finite transforms, Blender source reopen, portable GLB clean import, correct orientation and meter scale.
No rig, animation, physics, populated-world GPU cost, user acceptance or deployment is established. Mark those UNKNOWN.
prohibited: No GitHub upload/PR/deploy from this task. Private process/reference evidence only.
Do not reuse or recolor Edaphosaurus geometry; one genus ID only. Stop if same-taxon historical candidate is found.
